H8465H.name: Tahan
H8465H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8465H.brief: Son of Telah, from the tribe of Ephraim
H8465H.short: Tahan was a descendant of Ephraim, the son of Telah and father of Ladan.

H8465G.name: Tahan
H8465G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8465G.brief: Son of Ephraim, ancestor of the Tahanites clan
H8465G.short: Tahan was a son of Ephraim and the ancestor of the Tahanites clan.

H8477.name: Tahash
H8477.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8477.short: Tahash was a son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his concubine Reumah.

H8480H.name: Tahath
H8480H.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8480H.brief: Levite of the Kohathite clan, son of Assir
H8480H.short: Tahath was a Levite of the Kohathite clan, the son of Assir and father of Uriel.

H8480I.name: Tahath
H8480I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8480I.short: Tahath, a descendant of Ephraim mentioned in the genealogy.

H8480J.name: Tahath
H8480J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8480J.short: Tahath, another descendant of Ephraim mentioned in the genealogy.

H8472G.name: Tahpenes
H8472G.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H8472G.brief: Egyptian queen who raised Hadad the Edomite
H8472G.short: Tahpenes was the queen of Egypt who gave her sister in marriage to Hadad the Edomite.

H8468.name: Tehinnah
H8468.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8468.brief: Father of Ir-nahash from the tribe of Judah
H8468.short: Tehinnah was the father of Ir-nahash and a descendant of Chelub from the tribe of Judah.

H8485G.name: Tema
H8485G.desc: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8485G.brief: Son of Ishmael, associated with an Arabian city
H8485G.short: Tema was a son of Ishmael and is associated with the ancient Arabian city of Tema.

H8487G.name: Teman
H8487G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8487G.brief: Grandson of Esau, associated with an Edomite clan
H8487G.short: Teman was a grandson of Esau and is associated with an important Edomite clan known for its wisdom.

H8488.name: Temeni
H8488.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8488.brief: Son of Ashhur (or 'Ashur') from the tribe of Judah
H8488.short: Temeni was a son of Ashhur (or 'Ashur') and a descendant of Judah.

H8402.name: Tibni
H8402.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8402.brief: Rival to Omri for the throne of Israel
H8402.short: Tibni was a rival to Omri for the throne of Israel, leading to a divided kingdom until his death.

H8413.name: Tidal
H8413.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8413.brief: King of Goiim, ally of Chedorlaomer
H8413.short: Tidal, king of Goiim, was one of the four kings allied with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the plain.

H8407.name: Tiglath-pileser
H8407.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8407.brief: Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel
H8407.short: Tiglath-pileser, also known as Pul, was an Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel and received tribute from King Menahem.

H8436.name: Tilon
H8436.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8436.brief: Son of Shimon from the tribe of Judah
H8436.short: Tilon was a son of Shimon, a descendant of Judah.

H8494.name: Tiras
H8494.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8494.brief: Son of Japheth, grandson of Noah
H8494.short: Tiras was a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah, listed among the nations descended from Noah after the flood.

H8493.name: Tiria
H8493.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8493.brief: Son of Jehallelel from the tribe of Judah
H8493.short: Tiria was a son of Jehallelel, a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H8491.name: Tizites
H8491.brief: Clan from the tribe of Manasseh
H8491.short: The Tizites were a clan from the tribe of Manasseh, mentioned among the mighty warriors who joined David at Ziklag.

H8425G.name: Togarmah
H8425G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8425G.brief: Son of Gomer, grandson of Japheth
H8425G.short: Togarmah was a son of Gomer and grandson of Japheth, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H8459.name: Tohu
H8459.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H8459.short: Tohu, also known as Nahath or Toah, was an ancestor of the prophet Samuel, mentioned in his genealogy.

H8439G.name: Tola
H8439G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8439G.brief: Son of Issachar, ancestor of the Tolaites
H8439G.short: Tola was a son of Issachar and the ancestor of the Tolaite clan.

H8439H.name: Tola
H8439H.brief: Judge of Israel who succeeded Abimelech
H8439H.short: Tola, the son of Puah, was a judge of Israel who ruled for 23 years after Abimelech's death.

H8422G.name: Tubal
H8422G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8422G.brief: Son of Japheth, grandson of Noah
H8422G.short: Tubal was a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H8423.name: Tubal-cain
H8423.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8423.short: Tubal-cain, a descendant of Cain, was the first metalworker mentioned in the Bible, forging tools out of bronze and iron.

H8425H.name: Beth-togarmah
H8425H.brief: Region or people group trading with Tyre, allied with Gog.
H8425H.short: Beth-togarmah was a region or people group that traded horses and mules with Tyre and was allied with Gog, a future enemy of Israel.

H8483.name: Tahtim-hodshi
H8483.brief: A place visited during David's census of Israel
H8483.short: Kadesh, a place visited by Joab during David's census of Israel (<ref="2Sa.24.6">2Sa.24.6</ref>).

H8404.name: Taberah
H8404.brief: Israelite camp where God sent fire as judgment
H8404.short: Taberah, a place where the Israelites camped and experienced God's judgment by fire for their complaints (<ref="Num. 11:3; Deut. 9:22">Num. 11:3; Deut. 9:22</ref>).

H8412.name: Tadmor
H8412.brief: City built by Solomon in the wilderness
H8412.short: Tadmor (or Tamar), a city built by Solomon in the wilderness, possibly the later site of Palmyra (<ref="1Kgs. 9:18; 2Chr. 8:4">1Kgs. 9:18; 2Chr. 8:4</ref>).

H8480G.name: Tahath
H8480G.brief: Israelite campsite during the wilderness journey
H8480G.short: Tahath, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey (<ref="Num. 33:26-27">Num. 33:26-27</ref>).

H8471.name: Tahpanhes
H8471.brief: Egyptian city where Jewish refugees fled after Jerusalem's destruction
H8471.short: Tahpanhes (or Tehaphnehes), an Egyptian city where Jewish refugees, including Jeremiah, settled after the destruction of Jerusalem (<ref="Jer. 43:7-9; 44:1; 46:14; Ezek. 30:18">Jer. 43:7-9; 44:1; 46:14; Ezek. 30:18</ref>).

H8485H.name: Tema
H8485H.brief: Arabian city and tribe known for trade
H8485H.short: Tema, an Arabian city and tribe known for its caravans and trade, mentioned in prophetic and poetic texts (<ref="Job.6.19; Isa. 21:14; Jer. 25:23">Job.6.19; Isa. 21:14; Jer. 25:23</ref>).

H8487H.name: Teman
H8487H.brief: Region and town in Edom, known for wisdom
H8487H.short: Teman, a region and town in Edom, named after Esau's grandson, known for its wisdom (<ref="Jer. 49:7; Amo.1.12; Obad. 1:9">Jer. 49:7; Amo.1.12; Obad. 1:9</ref>).

H8405.name: Thebez
H8405.brief: Canaanite city where Abimelech was killed
H8405.short: Thebez, a Canaanite city where Abimelech was fatally wounded by a millstone thrown by a woman (<ref="Judg. 9:50-54; 2Sam. 11:21">Judg. 9:50-54; 2Sam. 11:21</ref>).

H8453B.name: Tishbe
H8453B.short: Tishbe (or Tishbite), the hometown of the prophet Elijah, located in Gilead (<ref="1Kgs. 17:1; 21:17, 28; 2Kgs. 1:3, 8; 9:36">1Kgs. 17:1; 21:17, 28; 2Kgs. 1:3, 8; 9:36</ref>).

H8434.name: Tolad
H8434.brief: Town in the territory of Simeon
H8434.short: Tolad, a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon (<ref="1Chr. 4:29">1Chr. 4:29</ref>).

H8422H.name: Tubal
H8422H.brief: A nation, descendant of Japheth, known for trading
H8422H.short: Tubal, a nation descended from Japheth, known for trading in slaves and bronze, and allied with Gog in the prophecy of Ezekiel (<ref="Gen. 10:2; Isa. 66:19; Ezek. 27:13; 38:2-3; 39:1">Gen. 10:2; Isa. 66:19; Ezek. 27:13; 38:2-3; 39:1</ref>).
